text: 刚从闺蜜那里听来这样一个故事：
en: I have just heard a story like this from my best friend:

text: 有一个女孩，同时被两个男人追求。
en: There was a girl who was being pursued by two men at the same time.

text: 这两个男人都很优秀，女孩不知道如何抉择？
en: Both of these men were excellent, and the girl did not know how to choose?

text: 刚好爆发了疫情，女孩灵机一动分别打电话给两个男人，谎称自己发烧，可能感染了冠状肺炎，她自己一个人呆着特别害怕。
en: Just as the epidemic broke out, the girl had a brainwave and called the two men separately, falsely claiming she had a fever and might have caught coronavirus pneumonia, and that she was terrified staying all alone by herself.

text: 第一个男人听到后，立即说：“为了你好我好，赶紧去医院。
en: After the first man heard this, he immediately said: "For your own good and mine, go to hospital straight away.

text: 另一个男人接到电话后，毫不犹豫地赶到女孩的住所，进门就拥吻了她。
en: After receiving the call, the other man rushed to the girl's residence without the slightest hesitation and embraced and kissed her the moment he walked through the door.

text: 女孩说：你不怕我传染你？
en: The girl said, 'Aren't you afraid I will infect you?'

text: 男人说，没有你，我活着又有什么意义？
en: The man said, 'Without you, what meaning is there in my living?'

text: 假如你是这个女孩，你将选择哪个男人？
en: If you were this girl, which man would you choose?

text: 我知道大多数的女孩都会选择后一个男人，有个男人肯为你去死，你还有什么话说。
en: I know most girls would choose the latter man—if a man is willing to die for you, what more is there to say?

text: 就这样，两人愉快地生活在了一起。
en: And so the two lived happily together.

text: 为了男人好，女孩让男人戒烟戒酒，不允许他点快餐外卖，甚至不允许他外出见朋友......
en: For the man's own good, the girl made him give up smoking and drinking, forbade him from ordering fast-food takeaways, and would not even let him go out to see friends...

text: 她爱他，她就得为他的安全考虑，尤其是在特殊时期。
en: She loved him, so she had to consider his safety, especially during this special period.

text: 一周，一个月......随着时间的推移，男人觉得这样的生活实在太枯燥，太无聊，完全不是自己想象的那样。
en: A week, a month... as time went by, the man felt this life was truly too dull and too boring, nothing like what he had imagined.

text: 他们开始吵架，女孩哭，男人叹气。
en: They began to quarrel; the girl cried and the man sighed.

text: 最后男人对女孩说，我们分手吧！
en: Finally the man said to the girl, 'Let's break up!'

text: 我实在受不了这样的生活。
en: I simply cannot bear this kind of life.

text: 女孩泪眼婆娑地说：“可是几个月前，你甚至可以为我去死。
en: The girl said through tearful eyes: "But a few months ago, you were even willing to die for me.

text: 现在你连听我的话都做不到，难道你已经不爱我了吗？
en: Now you can't even do as I say—could it be you no longer love me?

text: 男人说：“为你死容易，可是为你活着太难，也太累了。
en: The man said: "Dying for you is easy, but living for you is too hard, and too tiring.

text: 我得完全失去自己的生活，全部听命于你，这样活着还不如死了痛快。
en: I would have to lose my own life entirely and obey you in everything; living like that is worse than a quick death.

text: 这场爱，结束得比疫情还快——疫情还没结束，他们已经分手了。
en: This love ended even faster than the epidemic—before the epidemic was over, they had already broken up.

text: 有人说，女人心，海底针。
en: Some say a woman's heart is like a needle at the bottom of the ocean.

text: 其实，有时候，你会觉得男人的心也捉摸不透。
en: Yet sometimes you will feel that a man's heart, too, is impossible to fathom.

text: 就像上面的这个女孩，怎么也想不明白两个月前还深爱着自己的男人，怎么转眼就变得如此无情？
en: Just like the girl above, who could not make sense of how the man who had so dearly loved her two months earlier could turn so heartless in the blink of an eye?

text: 因为这个女孩太不了解男人。
en: Because this girl understood men far too little.

text: 男人到底是个什么样的物种呢？
en: Just what kind of species is a man, then?

text: 520到来之际，彬彬姐特意在彬彬帮的社群里展开了调查和总结。
en: As 520 approached, Sister Binbin specially conducted a survey and summarised her findings within the Binbin community.

text: 现将大家投票最高的男人身上的10个秘密分享给大家，希望在认识男人这条路上，你可以避坑，以及少走弯路。
en: Now I share with you the ten secrets about men that received the most votes, hoping that on the road to understanding men you can avoid the pitfalls and take fewer wrong turns.

text: 男人身上的10个秘密
en: The ten secrets about men

text: 第一个，女朋友≠老婆
en: First: a girlfriend ≠ a wife

text: 谁适合恋爱，谁适合结婚，男人心里是有一把精准的称。
en: As for who suits dating and who suits marriage, a man has a precise pair of scales in his heart.

text: 很多女人都很疑惑，为什么恋爱长跑了那么久，最后牵手走进婚姻的会是另外一个人。
en: Many women are puzzled as to why, after a courtship that ran so long, it is someone else who finally walks hand in hand with him into marriage.

text: 答案就是，在男人心中，你可能只适合做女朋友。
en: The answer is that, in a man's heart, you may only be suited to being a girlfriend.

text: 第二个，对“永远”的定义是半年到一年时间
en: Second: his definition of 'forever' is a period of half a year to one year.

text: 很多女人都喜欢听男人说，我永远爱你。
en: Many women love to hear a man say 'I will love you forever.'

text: 实际上，男人嘴里的“永远”是6个月到1年时间，女人的定义则可以是10年到50年。
en: In reality, the 'forever' in a man's mouth is a period of 6 months to 1 year, whereas a woman's definition can be 10 to 50 years.

text: 当男人爱上一个女人，他只会想像如何在短暂的未来与她亲密发展；女人则幻想到恋爱，结婚，生孩子乃至如何白头到老。
en: When a man falls in love with a woman, he only imagines how to grow close to her in the near future; a woman, by contrast, fantasises about dating, marriage, having children, and even growing old together.

text: 第三个，梦想跟多个女人发生性关系
en: Third: he dreams of having sexual relations with multiple women

text: 有句流行语这样说：十个男人九个花，一个不花身体差。
en: As a popular saying goes: of ten men, nine are fickle; the one who is not is in poor health.

text: 话说得很幽默，但后半句话有一点不太正确，因为身体差的男人一样可能会花心，只不过是心有余而力不足而已。
en: The saying is humorous, but the second half is a little off, because a man in poor health may be just as fickle—it is simply that his heart is willing but his strength is lacking.

text: 实际情况是，一个身体差到路都走不动的男人，心里也可能激情涌动、幻想联翩。
en: In reality, even a man too frail to walk down the road may harbour surging passion and endless fantasy in his heart.

text: 归根到底，应该说十个男人十个花心才对。
en: In the final analysis, it should be said that all ten of ten men are fickle.

text: 几乎所有男人都梦想——家里红旗不倒，外面彩旗飘飘，就像皇帝一样三宫六妾是作为男人的自豪。
en: Almost every man dreams—that the red flag at home never falls while the colourful flags flutter outside—and regards having, like an emperor, three palaces and six concubines as a man's pride.

text: 第四个，玩笑话里往往藏着真心话
en: Fourth: real feelings are often hidden in jest

text: 男人会通过玩笑的语气来试探女人的底线。
en: A man will use a joking tone to test a woman's bottom line.

text: 比如当他告诉你，他跟某个女人是一般关系时，你一定要警惕，他们关系绝不一般。
en: For instance, when he tells you his relationship with a certain woman is ordinary, you must be wary—their relationship is anything but ordinary.

text: 再比如，他告诉你，某个女人是他妹妹，那一定不是妹妹。
en: Or again, if he tells you a certain woman is his 'sister', then she is certainly not his sister.

text: 第五个，不喜欢聊前任
en: Fifth: dislikes talking about exes

text: 女人容易沉沦过去，但男人往往翻篇就是翻篇了，只要女人不提起，男人一般不喜欢议论前任如何如何。
en: Women easily drown in the past, but once a man turns the page, the page is turned; as long as the woman does not bring it up, a man generally dislikes discussing his exes at all.

text: 第六个，每隔一段时间都有一次情绪低谷期
en: Sixth: at regular intervals he has an emotional low

text: 类似于女人的大姨妈，男人每隔一段时间，就有情绪和体力跌到谷底的几天，躲起来不想见任何人。
en: Similar to a woman's period, every so often a man has a few days when his mood and energy hit rock bottom, and he hides away not wanting to see anyone.

text: 第七个，看不起下嫁的女人
en: Seventh: looks down on women who marry beneath themselves

text: 男人都有狩猎的本性，往往费劲追到手的女人，他才会加倍珍惜，相反那些屈尊下嫁的女人，男人往往从骨子里瞧不起。
en: Men all have the nature of hunters; it is only the woman he painstakingly chased and won who he will treasure all the more, whereas those women who condescend to marry beneath themselves are, at a fundamental level, looked down upon by men.

text: 第八个，嫌弃太穷的女人
en: Eighth: dislikes women who are too poor

text: 男人不仅在乎女人的容貌，也在乎女人的财富。
en: A man cares not only about a woman's looks but also about her wealth.

text: 在男人眼里，婚姻不是精准扶贫，他们绝对不会娶经济条件跟自己相差太远的女人。
en: In a man's eyes, marriage is not targeted poverty alleviation, and they would absolutely never marry a woman whose economic circumstances differ too greatly from their own.

text: 第九个，永远都会有所保留
en: Ninth: always holds something back

text: 女人都喜欢男人对自己坦诚相待，希望男人能将所有的经历、想法都告诉自己。
en: Women all like men to treat them with complete honesty, hoping a man will tell them all his experiences and thoughts.

text: 但男人的倾诉往往都是经过包装或刻意切碎的，因为他们根本不想被人彻底了解。
en: But a man's confidences are often packaged or deliberately chopped up, because they simply do not wish to be thoroughly understood.

text: 第十个，非常介意被比较
en: Tenth: minds being compared very much

text: 在男人看来，女人拿自己的男人和家庭与别人比较是对自己男人和家庭的严重背叛。
en: In a man's view, a woman comparing her own man and family with others is a grave betrayal of her man and family.

text: 真实的油腻男生：
en: The real greasy young men:

text: 1，死要面子
en: 1. Obsessed with saving face

text: 男生为了在团队里面不被欺负，往往把面子看得比什么都重要，平时点个外卖都要搜几个1元2元代金券的男生，在聚餐时却爱争着买单，生怕席上的女生觉得自己没钱，丢了脸面。
en: To avoid being bullied within his group, a young man often values face more than anything; a lad who will even search for a few 1- or 2-yuan vouchers when ordering a takeaway will nevertheless fight to pay the bill at a group dinner, for fear the girls at the table will think he is penniless and lose face.

text: 为了面子可以透支自己的金钱、健康、时间，不蒸馒头争口气，死要面子活受罪。
en: For the sake of face he will overdraw his money, health and time; it is not about the steamed bun but about saving pride—he insists on keeping up appearances and ends up suffering for it.

text: 2，表面豪迈
en: 2. Bold on the surface

text: 男生说话大声往往不是真的嗓门大、而是为了展示自己的雄性荷尔蒙。
en: When a young man speaks loudly it is often not because his voice is genuinely loud, but to show off his male hormones.

text: 越是没自信的男生，在某些场合装得越豪迈，俗称“缺什么秀什么”。
en: The less confident a young man is, the more boldly he puts on an act in certain situations—commonly known as 'showing off what he lacks'.

text: 有事儿没事儿就喜欢骂别人“娘炮、计较、不大气”，其实小算盘打得比谁都精，请你吃了顿饭必然时时说出来，买了辆车一定要拍个照秀下朋友圈，还要做出是不经意之举。
en: He loves to call others 'sissy, petty, small-minded' at the drop of a hat, yet his own little calculations are shrewder than anyone's; if he treats you to a meal he will bring it up constantly, and if he buys a car he must photograph it and show it off on Moments, all while pretending it was unintentional.

text: 表面豪迈、内心精致，最小男人。
en: Bold on the surface, refined within—the pettiest of men.

text: 3，内心空虚
en: 3. Empty inside

text: 没有拿得出手的本事、没有让自己心安理得的技能，靠运气和混日子混学历、领工资，一边迷茫着自己的未来、一边在吃鸡和王者荣耀的时候骂队友。
en: With no real skill to speak of and no proper ability to take pride in, he scrapes together a degree and a salary by relying on luck and drifting through life, confused about his future while cursing his teammates when playing Chicken Dinner and Honor of Kings.

text: 内心越空虚，越需要找事情来麻木自己，除了游戏以外，还可以看片、打球、吃吃喝喝，就是不在自己专业里面钻研，还美其名曰“这年头，混社会混人脉才能挣大钱”，谁知年纪越大心越慌，危机越大他心越浪。
en: The emptier he is inside, the more he needs distractions to numb himself; apart from games, he can watch videos, play sports, or eat and drink—anything but study his own field—all under the fine-sounding pretext that 'these days you only make big money by mixing in society and building connections', yet the older he gets the more panic he feels, and the bigger the crisis the more reckless he becomes.

text: 4，恨人有笑人无
en: 4. Resenting those who have, mocking those who have not

text: 比自己帅的都是小白脸，比自己有钱的都是渣男运气好，比自己努力的都是学习学傻了没什么用。
en: Anyone better-looking than him is a pretty boy; anyone richer is a scumbag who just got lucky; anyone harder-working has simply studied himself silly and is good for nothing.

text: 然而一旦发现自己哪里稍微优于别人，优越感瞬间爆棚。
en: Yet the moment he discovers he is even slightly better than someone else, his sense of superiority balloons instantly.

text: “你咋这都不懂啊，来我给你说说”
en: "What, you don't even understand this? Come, let me explain it to you."

text: “那穷小子一看就没出息，以后别和他混”
en: "That poor lad looks utterly hopeless; don't mix with him."

text: “呵呵，要不是我运气不好，他能比得上我？
en: "Heh, if it weren't for my bad luck, how could he compare with me?

text: 5，半桶水响叮当，好为人师
en: 5. A half-filled bucket makes the most noise; he delights in playing the teacher

text: 听了几句19大报告就敢在女生面前大谈国内国际政治，玩个游戏谁不乐意听他指挥他能碎碎念你一下午，找到你半点儿口误能嘲笑你半年，自己一知半解就敢拍着胸脯当老师教导别人。
en: Having caught a few lines of the 19th National Congress report, he dares to hold forth on domestic and international politics in front of girls; in a game, if anyone is unwilling to obey his commands he will nag at you all afternoon; if he catches the slightest slip of your tongue he will mock you for half a year; though he himself only has a half-baked understanding, he dares to pat his chest and act as a teacher instructing others.

text: 越没水平的人，越喜欢用强势的语气指导别人，仿佛天下就他知晓一切，其实真的给他写一篇文章就漏洞百出、让他上台讲几句话就结结巴巴。
en: The less capable a person is, the more he likes to instruct others in an overbearing tone, as if he alone knew everything under heaven; yet if you actually ask him to write an article it is riddled with holes, and if you put him on stage to say a few words he stammers.

text: 呵，这就是油腻的男生。
en: Huh—this is what a greasy young man is like.

text: 欢迎关注我，日常剖析自己。
en: Welcome to follow me; I analyse myself on a daily basis.
